_doc: Step 32 (decision 2154445): published Gen-1 R1T vehicle specifications used by the render-lane truck proxy (blender/s11_truck.py) ONLY. Not read by any CAD/check module; params.json and rivian_reference.json (hashed in step27/out/PROVENANCE.json) are deliberately unchanged. Values are Rivian-published nominal specifications, not measurements of a specific truck; every value stays TAPE-REQUIRED before fabrication.

source.title: Rivian R1T Upfitting Guide, September 2025, 'Vehicle Dimensions and Packaging - Overall Vehicle Specifications'
source.pages: printed pp.27-28 (text-extracted 2026-11-27 from the local copy ~/r1t-topper-research/r1t-upfit.txt)

_unsourced_form._rear_bumper_doc: Revised after verify task 165492: -0.505 intersected the lowered tailgate (S17 slab z -0.525..-0.465). The top now sits 20 mm below the lowered gate's underside (bed floor 0.465 + gate 0.060 + 0.020); s11_truck.py asserts the bound. Still an unsourced visual form.
_unsourced_form._doc: Bed-frame metres (z = 0 on the rail top). The x-EXTENT of the bumpers and mirrors is published (overhangs, width incl. mirrors) and located by Rivian's plan view (Upfitting Guide p.59 outline, already in rivian_reference.json r1t_plan); their vertical FORM is not dimensioned in any source found and is a visual assumption.
